illustrations.text: A twists B's arm until B signs over his shop. Simple hurt, but the purpose is extortion: ten years under s.119(1), not one under s.115.
An officer beats a suspect to extract a confession. Seven years under s.120(1).
A mob fractures the arm of an officer serving process. One to ten years under s.121(2), with the new one-year floor.
A drugs B's drink to rob him. Ten years under s.123, whatever the injury.
A throws acid on B, disfiguring her face. Ten years minimum, up to life, and a fine payable to B for her treatment: s.124(1).
A negligently secures a scaffold that collapses and fractures B's leg. Three years under s.125(b); there was no intention or knowledge at all.
A plain punch with none of the aggravating features: the pack routes it to s.115 (one year), where that tariff is quantified.
No bodily pain, disease or infirmity at all: outside the chapter.
